turns.question: What was our GMV in September 2026, counting every order placed, cancelled ones included?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no GMV metric (total value of every order placed, cancelled included); the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR), which excludes cancelled orders, and Orders, which counts all orders placed. For 1-30 September 2026, Revenue (EUR) was 12,582.75 EUR (non-cancelled orders only) and Orders was 120 orders placed, cancelled included. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
